notes: ParserState and Scanner are invocation-local rather than parser-module singletons; dispose clears every retained source and mutable collection.
The five upstream context bits are scoped and inherited exactly; speculative callbacks must restore them naturally.
Additional question, asterisk-equals, and JSX rescan wrappers keep all direct scanner mutation behind ParserState.
Reparse is the third SpeculationKind path inside speculationHelper; counts, interning, and arrow-cache writes intentionally commit across rollback.
Matching-bracket related information, explicit semicolons, close-brace/EOF/line-break ASI, and JSDoc token advancement are distinct paths.
Covers tagged templates, declaration-like names, blank-name variants, spelling suggestions, unknown tokens, and generic fallback.
Error-before-next-node is consumed once; missing-list identity uses an invocation-local side table.
Identifier interning and original keyword kind are retained; invalid private and Unicode-escape forms recover without throwing.
The worker is split into literal, private, identifier-name, and computed branches with the same result kinds.
All 26 real contexts have exact bit positions, representative starts, universal EOF termination, context-specific termination, and recovery diagnostics.
Ordinary, delimited, and bracketed loops record fullStart and either advance or terminate; trailing commas and semicolon recovery are retained.
Intentionally absent: there is no syntax cursor or general incremental reuse branch; private top-level-await range reparse remains a later dedicated path.
